title: docs(spec): push vendor docblocks read ADR-0012 §6.1, not alternate channel plugins
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuKB8Sg6c6sVpL96ruVvdxaf)_

Fixes #29960

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：推送配置与推送设备的说明注释（含生成的参考文档页）以及推送服务文档页的一句话，改为按 ADR-0012 §6.1 的新口径描述国产安卓厂商；只改注释，不动任何 schema、导出或默认值。
- 为什么改：ADR 修订后，厂商只是托管推送中继按其路由的令牌类型，二期由同一中继接入华为/荣耀、小米、OPPO、vivo；旧注释仍说它们是“另一套通道插件”，会把后续扩展厂商的人引向错误架构。
- 风险与回滚：极低；纯注释与文档文字，`PushVendorSchema` 仍为 `apns | fcm`，回滚即还原本 PR 的提交。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts`（`PushVendorSchema` 注释那段）、`content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/push-service.mdx`（第 86-91 行）、`packages/spec/src/system/push-device.zod.ts`。
- 两分钟验证：`git grep -nE "alternate channel|separate channel" -- packages/spec/src content/docs/references content/docs/kernel` 预期无输出。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The docblocks that read ADR-0012 §6 as "the domestic Android vendors plug in as alternate channel plugins / implementations" now carry the reading ADR-0012 §6.1 (as amended by PR #29952) decides: `vendor` is the token type the hosted relay routes on, core ships `apns | fcm`, and phase 2 adds HMS / Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO and vivo behind the same relay, with no per-vendor plugin and no per-vendor channel.

- `packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts`: the module docblock's "Out of scope here" paragraph, and the `PushVendorSchema` docblock (still "closed on purpose"; a new value is still a spec change made together with its transport, now named as the relay's routing for that vendor).
- `packages/spec/src/system/push-device.zod.ts`: the `UserDeviceSchema` docblock's "Narrowed from" paragraph.
- `packages/spec/src/api/register-device-request.test.ts`: the file-header comment.
- `content/docs/references/system/push-config.mdx`: regenerated by `check:generated --fix` (the only stale artifact).
- `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/push-service.mdx`: the hand-written push service page said the other Android vendors "plug in as separate channel implementations". It now says only `apns` and `fcm` ship today, and the other Android vendors (HMS / Honor, Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo) are planned for a later phase behind the hosted relay, as further values of `vendor`, not as plugins or channels of their own. The page's own "The hosted relay: not served yet" section, which the sentence points to, is unchanged.
- `.changeset/29960-push-vendor-docblocks.md`: `@objectstack/spec` patch, because the TSDoc of a `src/**/*.zod.ts` file ships in the published declarations.

Comment text only: no schema, `.describe()`, export, default or test assertion moves. Citations of §6 for the device registry and its lifecycle stay as they are (`push-device.zod.ts` line 12, `push-device.test.ts` line 3, `protocol.zod.ts`, `notification-service.ts`, `platform-capabilities.ts`); only the alternate-channel reading moves, and where it moves it cites §6.1.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/system/push-config.test.ts src/system/push-device.test.ts src/api/register-device-request.test.ts src/api/push-relay.test.ts`: Test Files 4 passed (4), Tests 117 passed (117).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 generated artifacts up to date (after `--fix` regenerated `check:docs`).
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the three changed `.ts` files: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes

- The push service page (`content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/push-service.mdx`) carried the same retired reading. The seat widened the claim to cover it (claim amendment on #29960), and it is fixed in this PR. A re-grep of `content/docs`, `packages/spec/src`, `packages/services/service-push`, `packages/services/service-messaging/src`, `skills` and `docs` for "separate channel" / "alternate channel" / "plug in as" finds no other ADR-0012 §6 vendor reading outside the ADR's own quoted amendment text.
- `push-device.zod.ts` line 12, "(ADR-0012 §6, narrowed to what core ships)", cites §6 for the stored device shape (the registry), which §6 still is, so it is unchanged.
- No ablation: no tested behaviour changed.
